respuesta.pregunta: I need to set up order-workflow-api on my machine. What do I need installed, and what are the steps to build it, run the tests and start the app locally?
respuesta.respuesta:
The only version with a development guide in the documentation I found is 5.6.2-hotfix-1, so these steps come from that version.

You need Docker, Java (Spring Boot) and MySQL installed [order-workflow-api/5.6.2-hotfix-1/guide/development.md:L3-L7]. Then:

1. Clone the project with `retailcorp get order-workflow-api` [order-workflow-api/5.6.2-hotfix-1/guide/development.md:L9-L11].
2. Build it with `mvn package` [order-workflow-api/5.6.2-hotfix-1/guide/development.md:L13-L15].
3. Before you run the tests, add the private key used to talk to gh-proxy. Create the file `src/main/resources/workflow-gh-proxy.key` and paste the full private key into it [order-workflow-api/5.6.2-hotfix-1/guide/development.md:L19-L21]. Then run the unit and integration tests locally with `mvn test` [order-workflow-api/5.6.2-hotfix-1/guide/development.md:L23-L25].
4. To run the app, copy `application-local.yml.dist` from the `resources` directory and rename the copy to `application-local.yml`. Edit its parameters to match your environment, then start the app with `mvn spring-boot:run` [order-workflow-api/5.6.2-hotfix-1/guide/development.md:L29-L34].
